description: Reconciliation of the two Borromean-volume definitions (8G vs ln|Vol_q|). Determines they are the SAME post-τ volume Vol(K) linked by the Kashaev Volume Conjecture; the keystone audit's 5090× was a cross-τ category comparison. No fit.

definition_A_production.name: classical hyperbolic Vol(𝓑₃) = 8·G
definition_A_production.chain_stage: POST-τ (archimedean ℝ). topological-mass-formula Step 1: Re tr(τ̂_desc·Hol)=Vol(K), CS/volume corr.

definition_B_vol_through_tau.name: Vol(K)=τ_arch(Vol_q)=ln|Vol_q|, Vol_q=∏V̂_i ∈ ℤ[q^½]
definition_B_vol_through_tau.chain_stage: Vol_q is PRE-τ algebraic; τ_arch=ln|·| is the archimedean EXIT. The result ln|Vol_q| is POST-τ ℝ.
definition_B_vol_through_tau.kvc_bridge: kashaev-volume-conjecture.md: Vol_hyp = 2π·lim log|J_N|/N at roots of unity = regulator of a Bloch-group class. prop:vol-through-tau asserts this EQUALS the classical Vol(K)=8G.
definition_B_vol_through_tau.note: The keystone audit's −0.00144 = ln|trM_norm(q₀)| logs the PRE-τ algebraic number at q₀ — a category error, not the τ_arch/Kashaev regulator.

exact_functional_relation.is_log_or_exp_relation: NO. exp(ln_trM_norm)=trM_norm≈1 (round-trips to the trace, not 8G); ln(8G)≈1.99 (not ≈ln_trM_norm). 8G is NEITHER log NOR exp of ln_trM_norm. The '5090×' = 8G / |ln(trM_norm(q₀))| is the ratio of a POST-τ volume to ln of a PRE-τ algebraic number at q₀ — a cross-functor (category) comparison, not one functional map.

the_5090x_explained.interpretation: 8G / |ln(trM_norm(q₀))| = 7.328 / 0.00144 ≈ 5090. NOT a log↔exp relation (see exact_functional_relation). It is the magnitude of a post-τ volume over ln of a pre-τ number — cross-functor compare.

production_8G_over_hbar2_times_linking_w.stage: POST-τ classical Vol (8G) × H₄ linking_weight (Def A, production)

lnTrMnorm_over_hbar2_WRONGSTAGE.stage: ln of PRE-τ normalized trace at q₀ — CATEGORY ERROR (the keystone audit's −0.00144 reading; gives negative mass)

production_stage_verdict: CORRECT. Production uses the POST-τ classical Vol(K)=8G, which is exactly what prop:vol-through-tau says ln|Vol_q| evaluates to via the KVC. The q-volume functional (Def B) is the SAME observable computed the long way (open KVC asymptotic + per-crossing V̂_i). Production short-circuits to the SnapPy 8G — correct value, correct stage. Raw production m_avg ≈ 966 MeV (+2.89%) is unchanged; the +2.89% is the SEPARATE linking_weight residual.
verdict: (a) SAME OBJECT ACROSS τ — the '5090×' is a CROSS-FUNCTOR CATEGORY ERROR, not a numerical contradiction. Definition A (8G) is the POST-τ archimedean volume Vol(K)=Re tr(τ̂_desc·Hol) [topological-mass-formula Step 1, Chern–Simons/volume correspondence]. Definition B (ln|Vol_q|) is τ_arch applied to the PRE-τ algebraic generator Vol_q=∏V̂_i; prop:vol-through-tau + kashaev-volume-conjecture assert these are EQUAL by the Kashaev Volume Conjecture (the regulator of a Bloch-group class landing in ℝ as the hyperbolic volume). So ln|Vol_q| SHOULD equal 8G — they are the same Vol(K). The keystone audit's −0.00144 took ln of the q₀-evaluated NORMALIZED trace (≈0.9986), i.e. the PRE-τ algebraic number specialized at q₀ — NOT the τ_arch regulator/Kashaev-limit (an N→∞ asymptotic at roots of unity). Logging a pre-τ number is the category error. PRODUCTION USES THE CORRECT STAGE: the post-τ classical Vol(K)=8G is exactly what the KVC says ln|Vol_q| evaluates to. No volume-definition bug.
residual_open: Not the volume DEFINITION (reconciled here). The genuine open items per keystone §5: (i) the KVC itself (axiomatized as VolumeConjecture class — proved only for 4₁, some torus/pretzel); (ii) the per-crossing V̂_i factorization compute for atomic braids; (iii) the H₄ linking_weight 2.53 vs CODATA-λ 2.46 residual (+2.89%) = the separate λ_scale-absorbed item, NOT a volume-definition inconsistency.
discipline: No fit, no fabrication. m_p readings are raw at each stage; we report whichever follows, not the one nearest CODATA.
